additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466156-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370010] Charging issue CRM:00263000233
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0466156.
Following the previous analysis provided by my colleague, I report here the results of my analysis for the timestamps provided on 2025-12-06 for charger
Y2/S1 313508370010:
The first session was authenticated via App at 2025-12-06T16:23:16 on DC2 (I do not see the payment terminal configured for this charger).
The session failed during P03-CableCheck with the following error: code":67,"msg":"ERR_EV_DROPPED, vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B". This means the EV did not provide the correct pilot state, and the session was stopped because of it.
The vehicle was disconnected and connected again on DC2 at 2025-12-06T16:26:28. In this time, I see the connection to the Backend going several times online and offline. I do not see any authorization, probably due to the offline issue, and the session fails at 2025-12-06T16:29:02
At 2025-12-06T16:30:16 DC1 is authorized, the EV is connected and it starts charging at 2025-12-06T16:31:02.
The charger provides 100kW, but suddenly the EV started to request a lower current, until reaching 0 A current requested.
The session is stopped by the charger at 2025-12-06T16:32:39. The error shown is "expected pilot state change timed out".
For the first and third case, it seems clear that the EV had an abnormal behavior.
For the second case (missed authorization), this could be related to the toggling of connection with the Backend. As mentioned in ticket 0466073, this is currently under investigation with RC-IT in a separate way.
Please let me know if further analysis is required, or I can proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service

13629 Berlin, Germany
